# HDFC Bank Ltd (HDFCBANK) – Investment Note

## RECOMMENDATION SUMMARY

We maintain a **HOLD** rating on HDFC Bank with a target price of ₹1,895, implying 9.1% upside from current levels of ₹1,737.65. The limited upside reflects near-term integration headwinds offset by long-term franchise strength.

## INVESTMENT CASE

• **Dominant franchise with unmatched deposit franchise**: HDFC Bank remains India's largest private sector bank with best-in-class liability franchise, providing a structural funding advantage. The merged entity commands significant scale with a market cap of ₹13.2 lakh crore.

• **Post-merger normalization underway**: Following the July 2023 merger with HDFC Ltd, the bank is navigating integration complexities including elevated wholesale funding dependency, credit-deposit ratio normalization, and priority sector lending adjustments. Management guidance suggests stabilization by FY25.

• **Asset quality remains robust**: The bank maintains sector-leading asset quality metrics with disciplined underwriting standards. Strong provisioning coverage provides a buffer against potential credit deterioration in an uncertain macro environment.

• **Digital and retail momentum**: Continued investments in technology infrastructure and expanding retail distribution should drive operating leverage over the medium term, though near-term margins face pressure from deposit re-pricing.

## KEY RISKS

• **Margin compression risk**: Elevated loan-to-deposit ratio (post-merger ~110%) necessitates aggressive deposit mobilization, likely pressuring NIMs in coming quarters until CD ratio normalizes to target ~90%.

• **Integration execution challenges**: Harmonizing systems, cultures, and processes between legacy HDFC Ltd mortgage business and banking operations could take longer than anticipated, impacting operational efficiency.

• **Regulatory overhang**: Heightened RBI scrutiny on large private banks and potential changes to priority sector lending norms or capital requirements pose headline risks.

## VALUATION

Our ₹1,895 target price is based on 2.5x FY26E P/B, representing a modest premium to the stock's historical average but below peak multiples. This valuation factors in: (1) temporary margin pressure from liability repricing, (2) modest earnings growth as merger synergies materialize gradually, and (3) premium valuation justified by superior ROE profile (16-18% medium-term). At current prices, the stock trades at ~2.3x P/B, offering limited margin of safety. We await clearer evidence of deposit momentum and margin stabilization before upgrading to BUY.
